notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/midw8080/nl_280zzzap.cpp (NETLIST_START(lagunar), CC0-1.0, Colin Douglas Howell) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/lagunar-sound.nets.

Compared with both Laguna Racer game logic sheets, A084-90700-B622 (doc 1461b5f1ef33) and -A622 (doc 2e04e6b435f0), on 2026-10-20 -- every wire and port line of this file, not a sample. The two sheets have one circuit and one set of pin numbers; 86 of the 89 lines agree on both, and all sixteen LM3900 amplifiers are on the pins the data sheet numbers them by, as this file puts them. The noise generator agrees part for part (the zener is printed IN5239). Two pins are not numbered on either sheet and are MAME's: G4 switch A's input (pin 1 by elimination) and the MC3340's ground and output (3 and 7).

The three that differ are one switch. Both sheets print the bottom (76 Hz) oscillator's J4 switch as pins 4, 3 and 5 -- switch B, which the middle oscillator also uses -- and MAME puts it on 10, 11 and 12 (switch D). Its comment: 'mislabeled pin numbers on the schematics for 280-ZZZAP and both Laguna Racer versions ... The Super Speed Race schematic correctly shows this oscillator using pins 10, 11, 12'. Two oscillators cannot share one switch, so this file follows MAME; it is a correction of the sheet, logged, not read.

Neither sheet draws the LM3900s' or CD4016s' supply pins, so +5V on 14 and ground on 7 are MAME's ('these aren't shown on the schematics'); nor the unused switches G5_D, J4_C and G4_D, so whether the board ties their pins or leaves them open is not on the sheet. The sheet's +12V here is '+12V DECOUPLED' -- connector A pin 3 through 100 ohms with 500uF to ground, neither of which MAME has -- and the LM377 bridge amplifier at J1 that OUTPUT and J5 pin 9 feed is on the sheet and not in MAME.

This is the Laguna Racer variant, and every value in it agrees with the B622 sheet, including the six where B622 and A622 differ (R46 2.2M, R48 470K, R51 470K, R11 120K, C18 22uF tantalum, R30 100K -- the last read with moderate confidence, its middle digit faint).
